items.title: Codex is now generally available
items.summary: OpenAI Codex is now generally available with powerful new features for developers: a Slack integration, Codex SDK, and admin tools like usage dashboards and workspace management—making Codex easier to use and manage at scale.

items.title: Introducing apps in ChatGPT and the new Apps SDK
items.summary: We’re introducing a new generation of apps you can chat with, right inside ChatGPT. Developers can start building them today with the new Apps SDK, available in preview.

items.title: AMD and OpenAI announce strategic partnership to deploy 6 gigawatts of AMD GPUs
items.summary: AMD and OpenAI have announced a multi-year partnership to deploy 6 gigawatts of AMD Instinct GPUs, beginning with 1 gigawatt in 2026, to power OpenAI’s next-generation AI infrastructure and accelerate global AI innovation.

items.title: Accelerating AI adoption in Europe
items.summary: OpenAI and Allied for Startups release the Hacktivate AI report with 20 actionable policy ideas to accelerate AI adoption in Europe, boost competitiveness, and empower innovators.

items.title: Introducing AgentKit, new Evals, and RFT for agents
items.summary: Today, we’re releasing new tools to help developers go from prototype to production faster: AgentKit, expanded evals capabilities, and reinforcement fine-tuning for agents.
